edges.reason: msg.sender is read inside the _msgSender context helper.
transfer forwards _msgSender() as the sender of the token movement.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() for allowance checks and approval updates.
block.timestamp is used directly as the swap deadline, creating timestamp dependence.
The router swap is an external call that transfers control to Uniswap outside the contract.
tokenAmount flows from the private swap into the external router swap call.
The transfer amount feeds the fee arithmetic amount.mul(txFees).div(100).
txFees multiplies the transfer amount inside the fee calculation.
The computed fee is subtracted from amount inside _transfer.
_transfer conditionally calls _swapTokensForETH when the swap threshold is met.
_transfer writes the blacklist for early buyers after a pair buy.
addBlacklist drives a blacklist state write.
removeBlacklist drives a blacklist state write.
Blacklist write mutates the isBlacklisted mapping.
addBlacklist mutates isBlacklisted under owner control.
_transfer reads isBlacklisted to block blacklisted senders.
_transfer performs the underlying balance-changing super._transfer effect.
_transfer enforces the maxTxLimit for transfers.
_transfer enforces the maxWalletLimit for recipients.
_transfer compares contract balance against swapAtAmount.
_transfer reads isExcludedFromFees for launch gating and fee waiving.
_transfer compares from/to against the uniswapV2Pair address.
_transfer reads isLaunched to gate trading before launch.
_transfer reads launchBlock to blacklist early buyers after launch.
launchNow sets isLaunched to true.
launchNow records the current block number in launchBlock.
setFee assigns the new fee to the txFees state variable.
newFee parameter is written into txFees by setFee.
newWallet parameter is assigned to the dev state variable.
updateDevWallet redirects the dev recipient address.
dev is the ETH recipient of the router swap output.
_swapTokensForETH reads uniswapV2Pair-related router WETH path.
excludeFromAllLimits calls excludeFromFees.
excludeFromAllLimits calls excludeFromTxLimit.
excludeFromAllLimits calls excludeFromWalletLimit.

Constructor assigns the dev address from its argument.
The swap path is guarded by the swapping flag set around _swapTokensForETH.
canSwap local gates entry into the fee swap branch.
The fee local variable is derived from the transfer amount.
Collected fees are moved to the contract via the underlying transfer effect.
takeFee local influences whether the swap path and fee logic execute.

normalization_plan.reason: _transfer.from is an input parameter that only exists to drive the _transfer logic.
_transfer.to is an input parameter that only exists to drive the _transfer logic.
_transfer.amount flows directly into the fee arithmetic unsafe operation.
_swapTokensForETH.tokenAmount flows directly into the external router swap call.
addBlacklist.account parameter only exists to drive the addBlacklist function.
_setBlacklist.value is written into the blacklist mapping unsafe operation.
setFee.newFee parameter only exists to drive the setFee function.
updateDevWallet.newWallet parameter only exists to drive updateDevWallet.
_transfer.fees local is the direct result of the fee arithmetic unsafe operation.
_transfer.takeFee local controls whether the fee swap flow is active.
